key_points: RMB5.2 billion regulatory penalty is a material one-time hit and signals ongoing regulatory risk for TCOM
Q2 2026 revenue of RMB15.7B (+6% YoY) reflects decelerating overall growth with domestic market under pressure
International platform revenue exceeding +50% YoY is a strong structural growth offset and key long-term thesis pillar
The net outlook hinges on whether international expansion can sustainably outrun domestic softness and absorb penalty-related costs
Generic Yahoo Finance and TradingKey listings provide no incremental information and are treated as noise
